scripts.dev: npm run contracts:build && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,frontend,backend --prefix-colors yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @vehicle-cost/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @vehicle-cost/client" "npm run dev --workspace @vehicle-cost/server"
scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @vehicle-cost/client && npm run build --workspace @vehicle-cost/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && npm run typecheck --workspace @vehicle-cost/client && npm run typecheck --workspace @vehicle-cost/server
scripts.test: npm run contracts:build && npm run test --workspace @vehicle-cost/server && npm run test --workspace @vehicle-cost/client
